1.web: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse says, the man who was raised on high says, the anointed of the God of Jacob, the sweet psalmist of Israel:
1.asv: Now these are the last words of David. David the son of Jesse saith, And the man who was raised on high saith, The anointed of the God of Jacob, And the sweet psalmist of Israel:

2.web: “The Spirit of Yahweh spoke by me. His word was on my tongue.
2.asv: The Spirit of Jehovah spake by me, And his word was upon my tongue.

3.web: The God of Israel said, the Rock of Israel spoke to me, ‘One who rules over men righteously, who rules in the fear of God,
3.asv: The God of Israel said, The Rock of Israel spake to me: One that ruleth over men righteously, That ruleth in the fear of God,

4.web: shall be as the light of the morning, when the sun rises, a morning without clouds, when the tender grass springs out of the earth, through clear shining after rain.’
4.asv: He shall beas the light of the morning, when the sun riseth, A morning without clouds, Whenthe tender grassspringeth out of the earth, Through clear shining after rain.

5.web: Most certainly my house is not so with God, yet he has made with me an everlasting covenant, ordered in all things, and sure, for it is all my salvation, and all my desire, although he doesn’t make it grow.
5.asv: Verily my house is not so with God; Yet he hath made with me an everlasting covenant, Ordered in all things, and sure: For it is all my salvation, and allmydesire, Although he maketh it not to grow.

6.web: But all of the ungodly shall be as thorns to be thrust away, because they can’t be taken with the hand,
6.asv: But the ungodly shall be all of them as thorns to be thrust away, Because they cannot be taken with the hand;

7.web: But the man who touches them must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear. They shall be utterly burned with fire in their place.”
7.asv: But the man that toucheth them Must be armed with iron and the staff of a spear: And they shall be utterly burned with fire in their place.

8.web: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb Basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.
8.asv: These are the names of the mighty men whom David had: Josheb-basshebeth a Tahchemonite, chief of the captains; the same was Adino the Eznite, against eight hundred slain at one time.

9.web: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines who were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away.
9.asv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodai the son of an Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away.

10.web: He arose, and struck the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand froze to the sword; and Yahweh worked a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take plunder.
10.asv: He arose, and smote the Philistines until his hand was weary, and his hand clave unto the sword; and Jehovah wrought a great victory that day; and the people returned after him only to take spoil.

11.web: After him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. The Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where there was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.
11.asv: And after him was Shammah the son of Agee a Hararite. And the Philistines were gathered together into a troop, where was a plot of ground full of lentils; and the people fled from the Philistines.

12.web: But he stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and killed the Philistines; and Yahweh worked a great victory.
12.asv: But he stood in the midst of the plot, and defended it, and slew the Philistines; and Jehovah wrought a great victory.

13.web: Three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time to the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
13.asv: And three of the thirty chief men went down, and came to David in the harvest time unto the cave of Adullam; and the troop of the Philistines was encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

14.web: David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Bethlehem.
14.asv: And David was then in the stronghold; and the garrison of the Philistines was then in Beth-lehem.

15.web: David longed, and said, “Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”
15.asv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me water to drink of the well of Beth-lehem, which is by the gate!

16.web: The three mighty men broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but he would not drink of it, but poured it out to Yahweh.
16.asv: And the three mighty men brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but he would not drink thereof, but poured it out unto Jehovah.

17.web: He said, “Be it far from me, Yahweh, that I should do this! Isn’t it the blood of the men who went in jeopardy of their lives?” Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.
17.asv: And he said, Be it far from me, O Jehovah, that I should do this: shall I drink the blood of the men that went in jeopardy of their lives? therefore he would not drink it. These things did the three mighty men.

18.web: Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. He lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.
18.asv: And Abishai, the brother of Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was chief of the three. And he lifted up his spear against three hundred and slew them, and had a name among the three.

19.web: Wasn’t he most honorable of the three? therefore he was made their captain: however he didn’t attain to the three.
19.asv: Was he not most honorable of the three? therefore he was made their captain: howbeit he attained not unto the first three.

20.web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab: he went down also and killed a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.
20.asv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, he slew the two sons of Ariel of Moab: he went down also and slew a lion in the midst of a pit in time of snow.

21.web: He killed an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.
21.asv: And he slew an Egyptian, a goodly man: and the Egyptian had a spear in his hand; but he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.

22.web: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things, and had a name among the three mighty men.
22.asv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had a name among the three mighty men.

23.web: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three. David set him over his guard.
23.asv: He was more honorable than the thirty, but he attained not to the first three. And David set him over his guard.

24.web: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,
24.asv: Asahel the brother of Joab was one of the thirty; Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,

25.web: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,
25.asv: Shammah the Harodite, Elika the Harodite,

26.web: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,
26.asv: Helez the Paltite, Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite,

27.web: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,
27.asv: Abiezer the Anathothite, Mebunnai the Hushathite,

28.web: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
28.asv: Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,

29.web: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,
29.asv: Heleb the son of Baanah the Netophathite, Ittai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin,

30.web: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.
30.asv: Benaiah a Pirathonite, Hiddai of the brooks of Gaash.

31.web: Abialbon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,
31.asv: Abi-albon the Arbathite, Azmaveth the Barhumite,

32.web: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,
32.asv: Eliahba the Shaalbonite, the sons of Jashen, Jonathan,

33.web: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,
33.asv: Shammah the Hararite, Ahiam the son of Sharar the Ararite,

34.web: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,
34.asv: Eliphelet the son of Ahasbai, the son of the Maacathite, Eliam the son of Ahithophel the Gilonite,

35.web: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,
35.asv: Hezro the Carmelite, Paarai the Arbite,

36.web: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,
36.asv: Igal the son of Nathan of Zobah, Bani the Gadite,

37.web: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armor bearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,
37.asv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Beerothite, armorbearers to Joab the son of Zeruiah,

38.web: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
38.asv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

39.web: Uriah the Hittite: thirty-seven in all.
39.asv: Uriah the Hittite: thirty and seven in all.
